Intel expects greater than $25 billion in total capital offsets through these partnerships.

comparisons.peer_summary: On November 22, 2023, Broadcom acquired VMware for a fair value of $53.4 billion using $30.4 billion in term loans and cash on hand, and subsequently sold VMware's end-user computing business to KKR for $3.5 billion.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom disclose significant capital deployment to secure or expand manufacturing and technology capabilities, though Intel uses capital offset partnerships while Broadcom utilizes debt financing for acquisitions. Intel's SCIP program involves entering arrangements to receive capital infusions in exchange for operating rights, specifically noting a 2024 agreement with Apollo for Fab 34 in Ireland and a 2022 agreement with Brookfield for Arizona, with total expected capital offsets exceeding $25 billion. In contrast, Broadcom funded its $53.4 billion acquisition of VMware primarily through $30.4 billion in term loans and cash on hand, rather than offsetting capital against future operating rights. Both actions represent major capital resource strategies but differ fundamentally in execution: Intel secures future capacity via partnership offsets, while Broadcom expands its portfolio via leveraged M&A.

sentences.text: In 2024, as part of our SCIP program, we entered into an arrangement with Apollo in which we received a one-time capital infusion in exchange for an interest in the rights to operate Fab 34 in Leixlip, Ireland.
In total, we expect greater than $25 billion of capital offsets through these partnerships.

On November 22, 2023, we acquired VMware in a cash-and-stock transaction (the "VMware Merger"), in which VMware stockholders received, in aggregate, approximately $30.8 billion in cash and 544 million shares of Broadcom common stock (on a split adjusted basis) with a fair value of $53.4 billion.

We funded the cash portion of the VMware Merger consideration with net proceeds from the issuance of $30.4 billion in term loans under a credit agreement that we entered into on August 15, 2023, as well as cash on hand.
